{{Top|leg}}
'''G'aav'aar'oon''' was a location known for its cathedrals.<ref name="SACWS">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
G'aav'aar'oon was first introduced in the roleplaying adventure "[[The Nuns of G'aav'aar'oon]]", which was published in the roleplaying magazine, [[Challenge 43|''Challenge'' 43]] without [[Lucas Licensing]] approval and thus is considered non-canon. It was later canonized by its inclusion in the story ''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''.

===Non-canon content===
'''G'aav'aar'oon''' was an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] located in the [[Vodilux Star Cluster]]. It had once been a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fortress that was renowned for its elegant cathedrals until it was [[Battle of G'aav'aar'oon|destroyed]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The ruins of the fort were turned into a convent by a group of [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] healer nuns who soon took on the name the [[Nuns of G'aav'aar'oon]]. The convent itself occupied only a portion of the asteroid, and the rest of the old Jedi base contained a small hotel for visitors, several public chapels, all the docks and machinery needed by any asteroid base, and several kilometers of abandoned tunnels, which contained some [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]] and other vermin that kept standard visitors out of the areas. All of the old base's weapons were ruined, dismantled, or permanently deactivated, and the Nuns had no intention of rearming them.

Soon after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Imperial Scouts]] sent by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] attempted to frame the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] for the murder of the nuns' leader, Mother [[Grotrugga]]. Unfortunately for them, Grotrugga became a [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]], informing her sisters that it was in fact the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who murdered her. Because of this, the nuns invited the Alliance to make use of the peaceful asteroid, though they were adamant that it would not be used as a military outpost. Many Rebels took use of the asteroid's facilities, taking short breaks at the convent to revitalize themselves both spiritually and psychologically as well as to recover from the trauma of war.
